'''Portobello mushrooms''' are large mushrooms that can be prepared as a vegetarian entrée. They can substitute for [[Cookbook:hamburger|hamburger]] patties, or be eaten alone.

==Ingredients==
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Mushroom|portobello mushroom]] per person
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] (as desired)

==Procedure==
# Remove stems from the mushrooms, then wash and dry them.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] with olive oil.
# [[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] for about 10 minutes, alternating sides, until both sides are grill-marked.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* When cooking on a barbecue, mixing the oil with a water based liquid (e.g. balsamic vinegar) will cause the fire to flare more and give the food more flavour; [[Cookbook:Basting|baste]] them as they cook.
* Adding other flavours such as garlic and chilli works well. If you are in a hurry, just use vinaigrette dressing.

==External links==
* [http://www.gourmetsleuth.com/portobellosportabellas.htm GourmetSleuth article]
